label: Подойти
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for подойти (to approach, to come up to).

missions.phrase: Я подойду к тебе через минуту.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person perfective future. 'Подойду' is the 1sg future of perfective подойти, with prefix подо- on the future stem подойд-. 'К тебе' uses к + dative for motion toward a person.

Strategic focus: Second-person future. 'Подойдёшь' is the 2sg future of подойти, end-stressed on the ё, which must be typed exactly. The imperfective partner подходить describes approaching repeatedly.
Strategic focus: Third-person future. 'Подойдёт' is the 3sg future of подойти. 'К столу' uses к + dative 'toward the table'. The prefix подо- marks a complete approach up close.
Strategic focus: First-person plural future. 'Подойдём' is the 1pl future of подойти, end-stressed. Here 'подойти к началу' means to arrive right at the start of the show.
Strategic focus: Polite/plural future. 'Подойдёте' is the 2pl future of подойти. 'К кассе' uses к + dative 'toward the till'. The ё stays stressed across this future stem.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural future. 'Подойдут' is the 3pl future, completing the future scaffold of подойти. Note the future stem подойд- across all six persons.
Strategic focus: Suppletive masculine past. 'Подошёл' is prefix подо- on the suppletive past root ш-, with no и and no д. It is the masculine past of подойти and reports a completed approach.

missions.phrase: Она подошла к нам и улыбнулась.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Suppletive feminine past. 'Подошла' uses the irregular ш- past root with the prefix подо-, marking a female subject. Past tense tracks gender, not person.
Strategic focus: Suppletive plural past. 'Подошли' is the plural past of подойти on the suppletive ш- root, sharing nothing with the future stem подойд-. This closes the past series.

missions.phrase: Подойди ко мне, я расскажу секрет!
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Подойди' is the informal command from подойти, inviting someone to come up close. The imperfective partner подходить would frame a repeated approach.
